授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本授業は、多様な学問分野の学生を対象に、地球資源工学の基礎概念を紹介します。鉱物、化石燃料、水などの地球資源の生成、探査、採取、加工の過程を学び、それらが社会および環境にもたらす影響を理解します。実際の事例やディスカッションを通じて、資源利用に関わる世界的な課題を認識し、持続可能な開発に向けた解決策を考える力を養います。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course introduces students from diverse academic backgrounds to the fundamental concepts of Earth Resources Engineering. Students will learn how earth resources (such as minerals, fossil fuels, and water) are formed, explored, extracted, and processed, and understand their societal and environmental implications. Through real-world examples and critical thinking activities, students will gain the ability to recognize global challenges related to resource use and explore possible responses that support sustainable development.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Earth Resources (地球資源), Mining and Extraction (採掘と資源回収), Sustainability (持続可能性), Mineral Processing (鉱物加工), Environmental Impact (環境影響)
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
特定の履修条件はありません。興味のある全ての学生が受講可能です。
No specific prerequisites are required. The course is open to all interested students.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: In order to take the exam, you must attend 2/3 of the 8 classes. This does not mean that you can miss 1/3 of the classes. In principle, students must attend all classes. Also, arriving 30 minutes or more later or leaving early will be treated as one absence.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.その他: Active participation in class, including answering questions during lectures, doing exercises, and reviewing preparations.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
If the student will be (or was) absent from the lesson with the reason regarded as authorized absence, students must email it to teacher within one week from the day of absence and should receive an instruction from teacher. Students need to go to the ISI office to get the certificate of
authorized absence with designated proof.
